article_summary: The article describes a distal C-H functionalization of electron-rich alkoxyarenes using organic photoredox catalysis. The method relies on radical-radical coupling between a transient cyclohexadienyl radical (formed by azole addition to an arene radical cation) and various persistent radicals. This strategy enables complete meta-regioselectivity for alkoxycarbonylation, sulfonylation, pyridylation, and alkylation, providing a complementary approach to traditional Friedel-Crafts reactions.
